title: IEPFA and SEBI to Organize ‘Niveshak Shivir’ in New Delhi to Empower Investors and Simplify Grievance Redressal and Unclaimed Dividend Claims
body_text: The Investor Education and Protection Fund Authority (IEPFA), under the Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Government of India, in collaboration with the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) and Market Infrastructure Institutions (MIIs) is organising a full day ‘Niveshak Shivir’ in New Delhi on 17 November 2026, at Jacaranda Hall, India Habitat Centre . The initiative is designed to help investors and shareholders resolve issues related to unclaimed dividends, shares transferred to the Investor Education and Protection Fund (IEPF), and other claimant-related grievances. Shri Harsh Malhotra, Hon’ble Minister of State, Ministry of Road Transport and Highways and Ministry of Corporate Affairs and Dr. Pallavi Jain Govil, Secretary, Ministry of Corporate Affairs, have been invited to grace the occasion. Through the Niveshak Shivir, IEPFA aims to provide: 1: Direct facilitation for the recovery of unclaimed dividends and shares held for six to seven years with companies. 2: On-the-spot KYC updation and nomination-related services. 3: Immediate assistance and resolution of pending IEPFA claim-related issues. The Niveshak Shivir model promotes direct, intermediary-free engagement between investors, companies, and Registrars and Transfer Agents (RTAs). Dedicated service desks will be established at the venue to ensure prompt grievance redressal . For the first time in the Niveshak Shivir, companies with substantial unclaimed dividend accounts are participating directly, so that relevant and rightful claimants can get guidance from the companies themselves. The Niveshak Shivir forms part of IEPFA’s nationwide investor outreach and awareness programme , aimed at strengthening financial literacy, enhancing transparency, and simplifying the process of reclaiming unclaimed investments . The initiative reiterates IEPFA’s commitment to building a secure, accessible, and investor-centric financial ecosystem across the country. About IEPFA The Investor Education and Protection Fund Authority (IEPFA), functioning under the Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Government of India, is dedicated to promoting investor education, awareness, and protection through sustained financial literacy initiatives and collaborative outreach programmes nationwide. Interested claimants can register for the Shivir through the link below: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeEnQuu89P0h5zL8wWQZ5ksmNP5pFKphFmQEPOwzkbe6R03jg/viewform For more information, please visit: www.iepf.gov.in *** KT/ONP
